verdict.rationale:
Restate explicitly offers a BYOC model where the vendor runs a managed orchestration control plane inside the customer's own cloud account while worker code executes separately, and community confirmation notes 'we don't host the code ourselves ... it is really easy to deploy it wherever you wish' — matching the exact split described in the story. Additional docs reinforce that services can run anywhere (containers, serverless, VMs, k8s) while the server handles the durable execution journal/orchestration.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of BYOC specifically (only vendor docs + one community comment), and no detail on data-residency/network isolation guarantees for BYOC deployments.
